name: Hane Hidemi
source:
Hobbies: Watching movies, fishing, driving, cooking.
Special skill: Remembering director's name and movie title by looking at the first 5 seconds of most movies.
Likes: Movies, the sound of the drums, hot springs, his hometown, the sea in the summer.
Hates: The landlord of his apartment, long phone calls,
never-ending E-mail exchanges.

A freeter who works part-time in a movie theater.
